principle: The pairing user path is designed BEFORE hidden technical fallbacks. Discoverability is a P0 property: pairing must be findable by an Owner who has never read a manual.

first_run_flow.content: what the console is; the Tower is the Owner's own server; nothing leaves the device until pairing; SKIP is available (app usable offline)
primary card: what pairing enables (voce, archivio, missioni sulla Tower personale); 'Connetti ora' primary button; 'Più tardi' secondary
three concrete benefits + privacy statement (i tuoi dati restano sulla TUA Tower; nessun cloud di terze parti); 'Continua'
auto-detect first (LAN discovery + last endpoint test), then methods: SCANSIONE QR (consigliata) / CODICE NUMERICO / RETE LOCALE (LAN) / TAILSCALE (MagicDNS) / CONFIGURAZIONE MANUALE (avanzata)
camera scanner (existing QrScannerScreen engine); live state: inquadratura → payload letto → verifica scadenza
visible candidate-by-candidate progress (per-class rows: pubblico / LAN / tailnet / manuale) with skip reasons; bounded 45 s; manual fallback offered inline on NO_ELIGIBLE_ENDPOINT

the three-word phrase hint from attest is shown; the Owner matches it against the Tower wizard screen; PHRASE_MATCH_REQUIRED gate: 'Confermo che le frasi coincidono' checkbox enabled only after both words sets are displayed

the Owner confirms on the TOWER wizard (PASSO 3/4); the phone polls the ack route with visible countdown (window 300 s); AMB-8 honest state shown if the ack route is absent: 'Questa versione della Tower non espone ancora la rotta di conferma: aggiorna la Tower (delta server) oppure usa il codice numerico completo'
the device key is generated in the Android Keystore (non-exportable); the credential is committed atomically; NO secret is shown or stored outside the keystore
real v2 route test (capture open/commit or capability route); real latency; NO 'SIMULATED' value anywhere (P1-07 repair)
the negotiated capability set is displayed (voice, archive, streaming …) with the capability_negotiation_version
paired state with endpoint class + transport + device label; primary CTA goes to VOICE; Diagnostics always reachable

primary_card.it_body: La console non è ancora collegata alla tua Tower. Colleghila per usare voce, archivio e missioni.
primary_card.visual: monumental Tower imagery anchor (Immagine_Hermes_Tower), Dark Monumental / Marble Light aware, 2-tap-free: the card itself opens pairing

home_when_unpaired.rule: the card is the FIRST content on unpaired Home, above any offline content; it disappears only when paired=true

tower_surface_duties.route: TOWER (replaces the old TowerStudio drawer entry as the primary Tower destination; Tower Studio remains as an advanced sub-surface)
exposes: connection status (paired/unpaired/degraded/expired/revoked + endpoint class + transport + last successful connection + latency)
pairing entry (primary when unpaired: 'Connetti la Console')
endpoint and transport display (current + candidates + how selected)
revoke ('Scollega e revoca questa console' with confirm dialog + typed outcome)
pair again (after revoke or on demand)
advanced manual configuration (ADVANCED_MANUAL endpoint entry + dev trust path + numeric code entry)

reachability_contract.from_first_run_onboarding: 1 tap (the onboarding IS a pairing path)
reachability_contract.from_any_primary_screen: <= 2 taps (primary nav -> TOWER -> Connetti; or nav -> SETTINGS -> Connessione Tower)
reachability_contract.from_settings: Settings -> Connessione alla Tower -> Pairing e dispositivi
gates: PAIRING_HOME_DISCOVERABILITY_PASS — unpaired Home shows the primary card as first content
PAIRING_FIRST_RUN_PASS — first run walks the full flow to PAIRED or an honest typed stop
PAIRING_MAX_TWO_TAPS_PASS — pairing reachable within 2 taps from every primary screen
PAIRING_DIAGNOSTICS_PASS — Diagnostics entry present with retry/revoke

required_methods.SCAN_QR: primary; existing camera engine; envelope v2+v3
required_methods.NUMERIC_CODE: Owner types the 6-digit code + (advanced) the public endpoint or a previously discovered one; works without camera
required_methods.LAN_DISCOVERY: NSD service discovery on the home Wi-Fi (service type _hermes-tower._tcp); discovered Towers listed with host:port; TLS validated the same way
required_methods.TAILSCALE_MAGICDNS: Owner-entered or QR-carried *.ts.net candidate; guided ('attiva Tailscale sul telefono e incolla il nome MagicDNS della Tower')
required_methods.ADVANCED_MANUAL: explicit advanced sheet: full URL entry, validation, classification, dev trust path toggle — same typed contract, never a bypass

forbidden: pairing buried in Tower Studio or Developer menus only
mock or null results presented as pairing outcomes
